name: Magical Witch Academy ~Boku to Sensei no Magical Lesson~
original_name: マジカルウィッチアカデミー ～ボクと先生のマジカルレッスン～
source: The story takes place in a fantasy world where magic is commonplace. The protagonist, a young boy named Tsukasa, gains the power to make women lustful with just a glance after a certain event. Under the guidance of his mentor, an old wizard, Tsukasa studies magic in order to control this troublesome power. One day, he meets a beautiful sorceress named Sylvia, who helps him gain admission to an all-girls magic academy. Tsukasa strives to learn how to control his power while attending the academy.
